title: When More Motion Modeling Hurts: Causal Latency Compensation for Streaming Object Detection
description: Reproducible analysis code, frozen configurations, aggregate results, and audit records for causal latency compensation of delayed object detections. The study compares ego-motion-only propagation with universal ego-plus-estimated-object-motion propagation across YOLO11n, YOLO11s, and RT-DETR-L.
